frosted-glass.name: Frosted Glass (canonical glassmorphism)
antiPatternKeywords: blur on flat #fff page (refracts nothing → fogged plastic)
missing 1px inset white top-edge highlight (reads as sticker, not lens)
body text directly on glass with no vibrancy chip backing

liquid-glass.name: Liquid Glass (Apple WWDC25)
antiPatternKeywords: displacement map applied to text (illegible)
displacement scale > 30 (text swims even on chrome)
glass nested inside glass (HIG explicitly forbids it)

thin-glass-chip.name: Thin Glass Chip (iOS-style toggle, Control Center pill)
antiPatternKeywords: too much blur (the chip becomes invisible)
chip on flat solid colour with no substrate

vellum-translucency.name: Vellum / Tracing Paper Translucency
antiPatternKeywords: cool/blue blur (vellum is warm)
high saturate boost (vellum desaturates, doesn't intensify)
sharp specular highlight (matte material can't glint)

glossy-plastic-aqua.name: Glossy Plastic (Frutiger Aero / Apple Aqua / Windows Vista wet button)
antiPatternKeywords: gloss covers full height (collapses to generic gradient)
flat solid colour with no gradient
cool greyscale instead of saturated colour

matte-clay.name: Matte Clay (claymorphism)
antiPatternKeywords: every container puffed (clay must be ONE moment per screen)
saturated 0.20+ chroma instead of 0.04–0.08 pastels
dark bottom-right inset shadow missing (reads flat pill with glow)

soft-ui-foam.name: Soft UI / Neumorphic Foam
antiPatternKeywords: pure #FFF or #000 background (kills one shadow)
symmetric shadows with no implied light source
per-component shadow tuning (light jumps around)

ceramic-glaze.name: Ceramic Glaze (high-gloss porcelain finish)
antiPatternKeywords: matte fill (ceramic without glaze isn't ceramic — it's terracotta)
off-centre highlight stuck at fixed position

chrome-mirror.name: Chrome Mirror (Y2K chromecore / cyber-sigil)
antiPatternKeywords: smooth grey gradient (chrome is BANDED — sky-on-top, ground-on-bottom)
no inset highlight at the seam between bands
chrome on a colourful chaotic page (the reflection has to be coherent)

brushed-aluminum.name: Brushed Aluminum (anisotropic metal)
antiPatternKeywords: isotropic noise instead of directional grain
brushed pattern at huge scale (the grain has to be sub-mm)
circular highlight instead of elongated one

gold-leaf.name: Gold Leaf (rich warm metal)
antiPatternKeywords: cool-white gold (gold is warm — pull hue toward 80–90 in OKLCH)
smooth perfect surface (real gold leaf wrinkles)

copper-patina.name: Copper with Verdigris Patina
antiPatternKeywords: uniform green (real patina is ASYMMETRIC, lives in crevices)
bright orange copper (it tarnishes within weeks)

holographic-foil.name: Holographic Foil (Pokemon card / Apple Pay Cash)
antiPatternKeywords: conic-gradient(#f0f, #0ff, #ff0, #f0f) in sRGB — muddy brown bands at cyan→magenta
autoplay 2s infinite hue-rotate spin (epileptic + tells "AI generated")
iridescence on body type or form inputs

oil-on-water.name: Oil-on-Water Iridescence (organic dichroic)
antiPatternKeywords: regular gradient blobs without displacement
sRGB hue mixing (always OKLCH for iridescence)

aurora-mesh.name: Aurora Mesh Gradient (Stripe / Vercel / Linear)
antiPatternKeywords: full saturation rainbow blobs (no falloff)
no blur (banding visible)
mesh repeated in every section (it's a singular event)

material-tonal-surface.name: Material 3 Tonal Surface (dynamic-color elevation)
antiPatternKeywords: applying M3 tokens without surface-tint ladder (flat white-on-white)
mixing Material Symbols Outlined with Rounded
seed colour not propagated into containers and on-colors

pixel-bitmap.name: Pixel Bitmap (integer-grid surface)
antiPatternKeywords: antialiased SVG icons next to pixel sprites
drop-shadow blur on sprites
Press Start 2P at 14px (mush)

crt-phosphor.name: CRT Phosphor (raster scan with subpixel RGB)
antiPatternKeywords: scanlines on already-pixel content (double pattern fights)
scanlines without subpixel RGB
flat scanline opacity (real phosphor varies)

dithered-1bit.name: 1-bit Dither (Obra Dinn / Game Boy threshold)
antiPatternKeywords: Bayer + Floyd-Steinberg in the same scene (pick one)
dither over already-low-contrast content (clamps to single shade)

ascii-art-surface.name: ASCII Art Surface (text-as-pixel)
antiPatternKeywords: proportional font (must be monospace)
line-height > 1

datamosh-compression-smear.name: Datamosh (codec interpolation failure)
antiPatternKeywords: datamosh over still imagery (it needs motion to smear)
clean cuts between datamoshed clips (real datamosh is continuous)
excessive opacity (datamosh reads as material, not as filter)

rgb-channel-split.name: RGB Channel Split (intentional large-displacement chromatic split)
antiPatternKeywords: applying to body text at any displacement that breaks legibility
symmetric offsets (real chromatic aberration is radial, biased toward edges)
flat across the whole frame (real lens CA gets worse toward corners)

jpeg-block-corruption.name: JPEG Block Corruption (8×8 macroblock aesthetic)
antiPatternKeywords: blocks that don't align to an 8×8 grid (real JPEG is rigid)
smooth gradients between blocks (real JPEG has hard block edges)
applying to text (illegibility)

signal-interference.name: Signal Interference (hum bars, sync errors, vertical hold drift)
antiPatternKeywords: regular sine-wave (real interference is stochastic)
hum bars at the same position every frame (real ones drift)
applying with linear blend (use mix-blend-mode: screen or color-dodge)

nes-rom-corruption.name: NES ROM Corruption (palette-flipped sprites, garbled tile data)
antiPatternKeywords: sub-pixel scroll on glitched tiles (NES had no sub-pixel)
more than 4 colors in a single sprite (NES sprite limit was 3+transparent)
non-8×8 tile alignment

chromatic-aberration-lens.name: Lens Chromatic Aberration (radial RGB split toward corners)
antiPatternKeywords: uniform CA across the frame (real lens CA is radial)
very large displacement (becomes glitch, not optics — see rgb-channel-split for that)
applied to text without limit (illegibility)

barrel-pincushion-warp.name: Barrel / Pincushion Lens Warp (wide-lens optical distortion)
antiPatternKeywords: applying to UI controls that need precise hit-targeting
warping without pixel-snap correction (creates moire)
applying without a vignette (real wide lenses also vignette)

displacement-ripple.name: Displacement Ripple (interactive pointer-driven warp)
antiPatternKeywords: ripple amplitude > 30px (too cartoonish)
ripple over text (always readable rests > ripple)
displacement without coherent damping (rings should fade with distance)

heat-haze-shimmer.name: Heat Haze Shimmer (mirage / hot tarmac warp)
antiPatternKeywords: too-fast shimmer (real heat is slow)
shimmer that crosses sharp UI edges (always damp at edges)
over text (illegibility)

motion-blur-streak.name: Motion Blur Streak (directional motion artifact)
antiPatternKeywords: persistent blur at rest (real motion blur clears in 1 frame)
omnidirectional blur (real motion blur is directional)
applied to text mid-action (illegibility)

plotter-pen-line.name: Plotter Pen Line (HP 7475 single-weight ink-on-paper)
antiPatternKeywords: variable stroke width (a plotter uses one pen at a time)
filled regions (plotters don't fill — they hatch)
antialiased curves without ink-jitter

cad-blueprint.name: CAD Blueprint (white-on-blue technical drawing)
antiPatternKeywords: blueprint blue too saturated (real blueprints fade toward cyan-grey)
antialiased grid lines (real blueprints have crisp 1px ferrocyanide trace)
sans-serif body type (blueprint convention is mono / technical letterer)

wireframe-3d-line.name: Wireframe 3D (Tron-style line-only volumetric)
antiPatternKeywords: triangulated wireframe (use edges-geometry instead)
line thickness variation per face (real wireframe has uniform stroke)
antialiasing without bloom for the Tron variant

schematic-pcb-trace.name: Schematic / PCB Trace (circuit-board aesthetic)
antiPatternKeywords: diagonal trace routing at non-45° angles (PCB design has strict angles)
antialiased traces without copper-fill texture
solder-mask color too bright (real green is muted)

iso-line-drawing.name: Isometric Line Drawing (axonometric vector, no fill)
antiPatternKeywords: perspective convergence (iso is by definition parallel)
filled regions inconsistent with the line-only register
stroke joins not crisp at vertices

hand-architect-sketch.name: Hand Architect Sketch (Le Corbusier / Frank Lloyd Wright register)
antiPatternKeywords: uniform stroke width (real hand has pressure variation)
perfectly closed shapes (real sketches breathe)
antialiased curves with no tremor

ansi-art.name: ANSI Art (16-color extended-box character art)
ansi-art.oneLine: A glossy (CRT phosphor inheritance) digital surface.
antiPatternKeywords: using more than the 16 ANSI colors
non-CP437 codepoints (no curly quotes, no em-dashes)
proportional or anti-aliased fonts

monospace-code-grid.name: Monospace Code Grid (IDE / terminal text as visual material)
antiPatternKeywords: non-monospace fonts (alignment dies)
line-height < 1.3 (lines crush together)
proportional ligature spacing

uncoated-paper.name: Uncoated Paper (soft, porous, ink-absorbing)
antiPatternKeywords: perfectly flat #FFF background (uncoated is always warm-tinted)
high-contrast specular highlight (uncoated has none)
tile pattern visibly repeating (use masking to break the seam)

coated-glossy-paper.name: Coated Glossy Paper (magazine cover stock)
antiPatternKeywords: the same fibers as uncoated (coated is much smoother)
missing the sheen on hover

kraft-paper.name: Kraft Paper (brown unbleached cardstock)
antiPatternKeywords: kraft as a solid brown swatch (it needs visible fibers)
clean rectangular crop (kraft tears on edges)

parchment.name: Parchment / Vellum (animal hide, premium document)
antiPatternKeywords: uniform colour (parchment is naturally splotchy)
perfect rectangle (parchment has irregular hand-cut edges)

legal-pad.name: Legal Pad (ruled yellow paper)
antiPatternKeywords: lines that don't go full-bleed
missing red margin line
perfect type instead of handwriting

risograph.name: Risograph (limited-palette spot-color print)
antiPatternKeywords: perfect registration (riso is famously misregistered — 1–3px offset is the look)
smooth gradients (riso halftones, never blends)
full opacity inks (riso ink is semi-transparent)

silkscreen.name: Silkscreen / Serigraphy (textile + poster print)
antiPatternKeywords: too-clean ink edges (real silkscreen has slight bleed)
perfect registration
high gloss inks

halftone-cmyk.name: Halftone CMYK (newspaper / comic process)
antiPatternKeywords: grid-aligned dots for all channels (must rotate per channel)
dot size too uniform (real halftone is luminance-driven)
moiré-pattern alarms (caused by wrong screen angles)

photocopy-xerox.name: Photocopy / Xerox (toner crush)
antiPatternKeywords: clean colour photocopy (the look is mono-thresholded)
no streaks or dirt (real Xerox is messy)
smooth midtones (toner crushes midtones to black/white)

letterpress-emboss.name: Letterpress / Emboss (raised-impression printing)
antiPatternKeywords: light source disagreeing with rest of page
emboss/deboss on a non-paper substrate
colour text inside the impression (letterpress ink colour is muted)

watercolor-wash.name: Watercolor Wash (wet-on-wet, granulation)
antiPatternKeywords: hard edges (watercolor bleeds — edges must be soft)
perfectly even wash (real watercolor pools at edges)
no paper substrate visible through the wash

ink-wash-sumi-e.name: Ink Wash (sumi-e / brush-and-ink)
antiPatternKeywords: regular vector stroke (sumi varies in pressure)
black at #000 (sumi ink is dark grey with brown undertone)
no paper bleed at terminals

ink-bleed-on-paper.name: Ink Bleed (fountain pen / felt-tip on uncoated)
antiPatternKeywords: perfect type (ink bleeds organically)
uniform stroke width (ink width varies with paper absorbency)

pencil-graphite.name: Pencil Graphite (HB to 6B sketch)
antiPatternKeywords: pure black (graphite is blue-grey)
no paper texture visible underneath

charcoal-drawing.name: Charcoal Drawing (smudged, expressive)
antiPatternKeywords: clean uniform fill (charcoal smudges)
high-saturation accents alongside (charcoal is monochrome)

linen-weave.name: Linen Weave (Apple-linen / textbook substrate)
antiPatternKeywords: the weave at huge scale (you can't see it)
the weave at sub-pixel scale (Moiré)
no warmth in the colour (linen is naturally warm-cream)

denim.name: Denim (twill weave, indigo fade)
antiPatternKeywords: perfect uniform indigo (denim is uneven)
no twill direction visible
no fade at stress points

silk.name: Silk (lustrous fabric)
antiPatternKeywords: flat fabric (silk is always shifting in light)
no drape (silk hangs)

felt.name: Felt (matted wool, fuzzy)
antiPatternKeywords: smooth colour with no fuzz
no soft edges (felt cuts soft)

corduroy.name: Corduroy (ribbed pile fabric)
antiPatternKeywords: ribs without highlight asymmetry
rib spacing too small (becomes Moiré) or too large (becomes stripes)

pebbled-leather.name: Pebbled Leather (luxury goods finish)
antiPatternKeywords: perfectly uniform pebble pattern (real pebble varies)
no specular per pebble (luxury leather glints)
cold colour (leather is warm)

smooth-leather.name: Smooth Leather (full-grain, polished)
antiPatternKeywords: matte uniform (smooth leather always has subtle sheen)
no grain variation

weathered-leather.name: Weathered Leather (vintage, distressed)
antiPatternKeywords: uniform wear (real wear lives at touch-points)
no creases at all
bright fresh leather colour

film-grain-tri-x.name: Film Grain — Tri-X 400 (B&W, coarse grain)
antiPatternKeywords: flat-opacity grain over everything (grain follows luminance)
too-fine grain (Tri-X is COARSE)
colour grain (Tri-X is B&W)

film-grain-portra-400.name: Film Grain — Portra 400 (colour, fine grain, warm)
antiPatternKeywords: too coarse grain (Portra is fine)
cold colour grade (Portra is warm)

film-grain-cinestill-800t.name: Film Grain — CineStill 800T (tungsten, halation, neon glow)
antiPatternKeywords: halation everywhere (must be tied to bright spots)
flat blue tungsten (CineStill has WARM-red halation against the cool base)

vhs-distortion.name: VHS Distortion (chromatic aberration + scanlines + bleed)
antiPatternKeywords: static RGB shift (real VHS varies)
no scanlines (VHS interlace is signature)
no horizontal bleed

polaroid-instant.name: Polaroid / Instant Photo (square frame, faded chemistry)
antiPatternKeywords: all polaroids at the same angle (real ones scatter)
no chemistry fade
caption in a digital font (must be handwritten)

dust-scratches.name: Dust + Scratches (archival distress)
antiPatternKeywords: regular spacing of "scratches
same overlay tiled visibly
high opacity dust (must be subtle)

foxing-stain.name: Foxing / Tea Stain (paper aging)
antiPatternKeywords: symmetric stains (real foxing is asymmetric, lives where moisture pooled)
stains over photos (paper-edge-only)

torn-edge.name: Torn Edge (paper / fabric / film)
antiPatternKeywords: rounded "torn" edges (real tear is irregular and SHARP at peaks)
same tear pattern repeated

wood-grain-walnut.name: Wood Grain (walnut, dark, vertical grain)
wood-grain-walnut.oneLine: A semi-gloss (varnished) or matte (raw) analog surface.
antiPatternKeywords: regularly repeating tile (mask with noise)
isotropic noise (wood grain is directional)
perfect varnish gloss without grain

marble.name: Marble (veined stone)
marble.oneLine: A glossy (polished) or matte (honed) analog surface.
antiPatternKeywords: veins drawn perfectly (real marble is organic chaos)
matte without sheen (most marble is polished)

concrete.name: Concrete (raw industrial)
antiPatternKeywords: too clean (concrete is messy)
no cracks or stains
flat colour with no aggregate visible

scanned-glass.name: Scanned Glass (digital glass on analog paper substrate)
antiPatternKeywords: both layers at same z (glass must SIT ON paper)
no paper grain visible behind glass

risograph-glass.name: Risograph-Glass (frosted glass under riso grain)
antiPatternKeywords: glass sheen visible through the riso (riso must dominate top)

vhs-frutiger.name: VHS-Frutiger (Frutiger Aero with VHS distortion)
antiPatternKeywords: VHS effect blocking the Frutiger water/sky motif (riso-style overlay should let plate through)

holographic-paper.name: Holographic-Paper (iridescent foil on textured paper)
antiPatternKeywords: iridescence over the whole card (must be foil REGIONS, like a Pokemon card)

paper-with-watercolor.name: Paper with Watercolor (botanical illustration substrate)
antiPatternKeywords: watercolor without paper texture (looks plastic)
watercolor with hard edges

chrome-on-velvet.name: Chrome on Velvet (Y2K luxury substrate)
chrome-on-velvet.oneLine: A metallic (chrome) on matte (velvet) hybrid surface.
antiPatternKeywords: velvet that looks like flat dark grey
chrome at low saturation
